tiers.name: Free
tiers.who_its_for: Solo devs and small teams evaluating git-native flags
tiers.rationale: Matches Flagsmith free tier scope; enough to prove the git-native workflow

tiers.name: Team
tiers.who_its_for: Product engineering teams of 5-25 practicing trunk-based development
tiers.rationale: Sits between Flagsmith $40 flat and ConfigCat $110 flat; per-seat scales fairly

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.who_its_for: Scaling teams 25-50 needing compliance and higher eval volume
tiers.rationale: Half of Unleash $75/seat; justified once SOC 2 ships and mobile SDKs land

recommendation.positioning_note: Current $8/seat is 5-10x below market; $19 Team is still a clear discount vs Unleash $75 and defensible on beta status.
risks: No SOC 2 blocks enterprise deals regardless of price; ship compliance before raising Growth tier
Per-seat model punishes large teams; add an eval-volume flat tier once usage data exists
Beta label suppresses willingness-to-pay; time-box beta and GA before Growth tier launch
